_comment: Static Flesh and Blood deck database sourced from fabrary.net public links. Card names are matched to the rlbridge card DB at load time; any card not found in the DB or illegal for its format check using update_cards_db_from_fabtcg.py. If the expanded deck exceeds format size limits the excess is randomly trimmed; if it falls short, generic filler cards are appended.
